{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "40d9edf5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Experimental setup and regions of interest\n",
    "\n",
    "<div class=\"alert alert-warning\">\n",
    "\n",
    "**Experimental:** Regions of interest work, but the API may change and\n",
    "they are not yet integrated with the other methods (e.g., there is no\n",
    "method that returns the time spent in a region per trial).\n",
    "\n",
    "</div>\n",
    "\n",
    "Gaze positions are recorded in screen pixels. To relate them to what was\n",
    "on the screen, or to express them in mm or degrees of visual angle,\n",
    "`pypillometry` needs the geometry of the setup. Regions of interest (ROIs)\n",
    "then mark parts of the screen, e.g., where stimuli were shown."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "29fbc820",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import pypillometry as pp\n",
    "from pypillometry import u\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "pp.logging_set_level(\"WARNING\")\n",
    "\n",
    "d = pp.get_example_data(\"rlmw_002_short\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "dbbb993a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The experimental setup\n",
    "\n",
    "The geometry is stored in `d.experimental_setup`. For Eyelink files, the\n",
    "screen resolution is read from the file; the example dataset also has\n",
    "the physical screen size and the distance from the eye to the screen:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "3feb18a9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "ExperimentalSetup(\n",
       "  screen=1280x1024px\n",
       "  physical=300x200mm\n",
       "  d=600mm\n",
       ")"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "d.experimental_setup"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "888832cf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Missing values are set (or changed) with `set_experimental_setup()`.\n",
    "Lengths and angles take units:\n",
    "\n",
    "```python\n",
    "d.set_experimental_setup(physical_screen_size=(\"30 cm\", \"20 cm\"),\n",
    "                         eye_to_screen_center=60 * u.cm)\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "With this information, the setup converts between pixels, mm (relative to\n",
    "the screen center, y up) and degrees of visual angle:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "ff120d42",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "(np.float64(14.036243467926479), np.float64(0.0))\n",
      "(np.float64(280.2154631618779), np.float64(512.0))\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "setup = d.experimental_setup\n",
    "print(setup.pixels_to_degrees(1280, 512))   # right edge, middle\n",
    "print(setup.degrees_to_pixels(-8, 0))       # 8 degrees left of the center"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "068fd97e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "It also defines the screen boundaries, which are used, e.g., by\n",
    "`mask_offscreen_coords()` to mask samples outside the screen.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Where did the participant look?\n",
    "\n",
    "In this task, two stimuli were shown to the left and right of the screen\n",
    "center. A heatmap of the gaze positions of the left eye shows them as two\n",
    "clusters next to the central fixation point:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "3dacf3f4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "d.plot.plot_heatmap(eyes=\"left\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e635d2eb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Defining regions of interest\n",
    "\n",
    "ROIs are circles (`CircularROI`) or rectangles (`RectangularROI`). They\n",
    "are stored in pixels, but can be created from mm or degrees with\n",
    "`from_mm()` and `from_degrees()`. Here, two circles with a radius of 3°,\n",
    "8° to the left and right of the center:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "aa86d93c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(CircularROI(name=left stimulus)(center=[280.21546316 512.        ], radius=146.36063450682056),\n",
       " CircularROI(name=right stimulus)(center=[999.78453684 512.        ], radius=146.36063450682056))"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "left_roi = pp.CircularROI.from_degrees((\"-8 deg\", \"0 deg\"), \"3 deg\",\n",
    "                                       setup=setup, name=\"left stimulus\")\n",
    "right_roi = pp.CircularROI.from_degrees((\"8 deg\", \"0 deg\"), \"3 deg\",\n",
    "                                        setup=setup, name=\"right stimulus\")\n",
    "left_roi, right_roi"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e6f8d1ad",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "`plot_heatmap()` shows ROIs on top of the data:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "229da013",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "d.plot.plot_heatmap(eyes=\"left\", rois=[left_roi, right_roi])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e527f845",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Which samples are in a region?\n",
    "\n",
    "`contains()` takes an array of (x, y) positions and returns `True` for\n",
    "those inside the region. For single points, `in` works as well:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "ccfee543",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "True\n",
      "left: 14.6%, right: 18.7% of samples\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print((280, 512) in left_roi)\n",
    "\n",
    "gaze = np.column_stack([d[\"left_x\"], d[\"left_y\"]])\n",
    "in_left = left_roi.contains(gaze)\n",
    "in_right = right_roi.contains(gaze)\n",
    "print(f\"left: {in_left.mean():.1%}, right: {in_right.mean():.1%} of samples\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "301bbfdd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Combining ROIs with intervals and events\n",
    "\n",
    "The result is a boolean array with one value per sample, so it can be\n",
    "converted to [intervals](../notebooks/intervals.ipynb): the periods in\n",
    "which the participant looked at the left stimulus. Very short visits are\n",
    "removed with `filter()`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "b221bda8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intervals 'left stimulus' | 18 intervals (total duration: 5768.00 ms), 320.44 ms +/- 163.24 ms, [166.00 ms, 844.00 ms] | fs=500.0Hz"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "visits = pp.Intervals.from_mask(in_left, units=\"ms\", sampling_rate=d.fs,\n",
    "                                label=\"left stimulus\")\n",
    "visits = visits.filter(min_duration=100 * u.ms)\n",
    "visits"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "52a9c2bc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "To get the proportion of time spent on the left stimulus after each\n",
    "stimulus onset, we store the boolean array as a new variable and use\n",
    "`stat_per_event()`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "a24df618",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "array([0.418, 0.398, 0.476, 0.494, 0.25 , 0.366, 0.248, 0.384, 0.342,\n",
       "       0.412])"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "d[\"left\", \"in_left_roi\"] = in_left.astype(float)\n",
    "props = d.stat_per_event(interval=(0, 1000) * u.ms, event_select=\"S_\",\n",
    "                         eyes=\"left\", variables=\"in_left_roi\")\n",
    "props[\"left_in_left_roi\"]"
   ]
  }
 ],
